method: Actual 2560x1440 window, 60 FPS, VSync off. Sequential processes, each with a new profile and two loads. Every load performs fresh native validation, scene creation, material checks and actual window GPU-fence readiness. No compilation or concurrent benchmark. Timing screenshots disabled; packaged image/flow/traversal checks run separately.
cacheScope: Fresh process is not a claim of cold OS storage or driver caches. Hash verification reads executable/fixture files before launch. OS/driver caches are not reset. Startup is recorded separately.
statisticalScope: Empirical nearest-rank p99 on this host/configuration. All observations retained. If 0/300 exceed five seconds, the one-sided 95% binomial upper bound on exceedance probability is 0.9936%, conditional on independent representative trials; this is not a guarantee for other hardware or workloads.
